title: Seems ok, rope may pose an issue
text: Seems ok, rope may pose an issue. Umbrella itself seems pretty good, like the color. The rope that connects to the crank and hoists it up and down seems a little thin and we are worried about it's longevity because it is really tight. Sometimes the thin rope comes off the plastic roller at the top of the umbrella, which also can't be good for it. Once that part of the rope wears out, it will snap and render this useless. We'll see how it goes.
